notes: Schübler BWV645–650 six independent organ arrangements; BWV646 model lost. Other five cantata models linked specifically by movement.
Orgelbüchlein BWV599–644 collection distinct from Schübler and Leipzig Eighteen; 24 members in this current source batch.
BWV995 own cello BWV1011 transcription, BWV1006a own violin BWV1006 transcription; instruments for latter debated.
BWV561 authorship historical Bach withdrawn and composer unknown; BWV571 authorship dispute in hold.
BWV574 historical Legrenzi theme source contested by Bononcini op.6/10 possibility; both source assertions are non-definitive.
BWV562 incomplete fugue movement not independent complete fugue composition.
V9 global person and prior work references reused; documentary BWV137 snapshot sourced from LOTTO49, no new independent work certification.
All new claims staging source-specific, non-transitive and rooted; no graph production promotion.
